title: NSW, QLD, VIC and more - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Network maintenance affecting some services in NSW, QLD, VIC, and other areas has been rescheduled. This work is now planned to occur during the maintenance window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Wednesday 30 September 2026. During this time, a single interruption of up to 6 hours may occur for some services, and order or service processing may be delayed until work is complete. Maintenance has not yet started.

updates.content:
Some services in NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas will be briefly offline while our network partner completes planned upgrades. A single interruption of up to 30 minutes is expected within the maintenance window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 29 September 2026.

Orders and service change requests may process more slowly during and shortly after the window.

Most services should reconnect automatically. If your service does not come back online after the window, please restart your modem/router and contact our support team. We appreciate your patience while this work is completed.

The planned network maintenance affecting NSW, QLD, VIC and other areas has been rescheduled by our network partner. The maintenance window is now scheduled for 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Wednesday 30 September 2026, and some services may be offline for up to 6 hours during this time. Order and service processing may also be delayed until maintenance is complete. Maintenance work has not yet started.
